_comment: Reference schema for project-context/context.json. This is the single source of truth for the business-context contract every consumer agent reads. Consumers MUST read defensively: a missing field means ask the user or omit, never hard-error. Do not add consumer-specific fields here; per-run parameters belong in each agent's own config.json.

one_liner.description: One sentence: what it is and who it's for.

category.description: Market category in the words a buyer would search, e.g. 'freelance invoicing tools'.

geography.description: Where the buyers are. Optional. Consumers use it for search locale (SERP country, community scans) and never hard-error when it is absent.

country.description: Primary market country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase, e.g. 'fr', 'us'. null when the market is global.

notes.description: Free-text scope, e.g. 'France and Belgium, French-speaking'.

pains.description: Real frustrations, ideally in the buyer's words.

jobs.description: Jobs-to-be-done they are hiring the product for.

oneOf.description: V1 item: a plain sentence. Still accepted, read as an item with no kind, no source and no date (a warning in proof.py check).

proof.description: Evidence for the promise, and the only list of allowed claims copy-writing agents may use without a new source URL. An item is a sourced, dated object (definitions.proof_item) or, in the V1 format, a plain string. Consumers read it through shared/scripts/proof.py: only items usable() accepts for the copy's scope (fresh, sourced, consent granted when someone is named) enter a copy. validate_json.py ignores oneOf: run python3 shared/scripts/proof.py check <context.json> for the item rules. See voice.claims_policy.

banned_words.description: Words/phrases to never use in copy.

claims_policy.description: Rule consumers enforce when writing copy. Default: 'no invented stats, every metric must trace to a URL or be omitted'.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id, unique in the list, e.g. waitlist-size.

claim.description: The fact as copy may state it, numbers written exactly as the source writes them.

kind.description: Rules per kind (staleness, source, date, consent): agents/project-context/assets/proof-kinds.json.

source.description: A public URL, or a file of the project relative to the project-context/ folder, with #pN for a page of an ingested document, e.g. docs/deck.pdf#p7.

date.description: Date of the fact itself (the day the number was measured, the quote given, the article published), YYYY-MM-DD. Never the day it was typed in.

valid_days.description: Days the fact stays usable after date. Default per kind in proof-kinds.json (metric: 180).

proof_consent.description: Required for kind testimonial and customer: the named person or company agreed to appear, for these scopes.

scope.description: Uses covered: ads, carousel, posts, outreach, site, video.

date.description: Day the consent was given or refused.

by.description: Who gave it and how, e.g. 'the customer, email of 2026-10-02'.
